"""Deep composed pipe applications at scale."""
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

BR = 40                      # 40 + 40*40 = 1640 applications
TYPES = [{"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}, {"name": "I", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
MODULES = [{"name": "E", "params": [["a", "I"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
            "requires": ["lt", ["var", "a"], ["const", "I", 200]]},
           {"name": "T", "params": [["a", "I"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
            "requires": ["const", "B", True]}]
PIPES = []
for i in range(BR):
    MODULES.append({"name": "F%d" % i, "params": [["q", "I"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                    "requires": ["const", "B", True]})
    PIPES.append({"target": "E", "filter": "F%d" % i, "bind": {"q": "a"}})
    for j in range(BR):
        name = "G%d_%d" % (i, j)
        MODULES.append({"name": name, "params": [["q", "I"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                        "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"], ["const", "I", 77]]})
        PIPES.append({"target": "F%d" % i, "filter": name, "bind": {"q": "q"}})
campaign = {"types": TYPES, "modules": MODULES, "calls": [], "pipes": PIPES,
            "entries": ["E"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
start = time.time()
_, plan = kit.plan_for(campaign)
print("modules", len(plan["modules"]), "flag", plan["flag"], "compile %.2fs" % (time.time() - start))
RUNS = 600
campaign["runs"] = [{"entry": "E", "ktest": kit.encode(
    [("x0", bytes([v])), ("x1", b"\x00"), ("x2", b"\x00")])} for v in (0, 1, 254, 255)]
for i in range(RUNS):
    campaign["runs"].append({"entry": "E", "ktest": kit.encode(
        [("x0", bytes([i % 256])), ("x1", b"\x00"), ("x2", b"\x00")])})
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
elapsed = time.time() - start
from collections import Counter
print("%d runs x %d applications: %.2fs" % (len(out["records"]), BR + BR * BR, elapsed))
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
assert sum(1 for r in out["records"] if r["status"] == "FILTERED") == 1  # value 77
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_apps.py
